author: Ash_9988771

title: Straightforward and clean
body: This app does the job without clutter! DailyHabits helps me monitor progress in building new habits and breaking others. I love the clean appearance, the day/night mode and how reinforcing it is to check a box. I don’t want reminders or character graphics—just a digital tracker and DailyHabits is perfect! Customer service was fantastic when I made a silly log-in error. I also appreciate the one-time payment for premium rather than a subscription.
author: Scarlet Robin

title: Can’t access
body: Read a glowing review about this app. Downloaded. App asks to log in even though it’s the first time I’ve used it. Upon clicking “forgot password” I get to a webpage that lets me create a new account. Ok. Created new account. Set up some habits. Interface is nice and simple. Closed the webpage. Go back to app. Log in with newly created account. Get error message that only paid users get access to the app. Huh??
author: MindfulOfBugs
